summary:
Second review of w225 (0f01102e, 52207c77; same code as the implementer's 9ebc483f, 58c712f0).
No change under features/. No test removed or weakened: the p1 steps were widened to [pg]1 with the same assertions. The allowance 'none' holds.
The earlier r117 finding was answered (accepted as it is) and is not raised again.
New Important, fix now: glossary_only_done (supervise_glossary.py:66-67) reads ledger.md as a non-glossary proposal and returns False. Every round writes ledger.md, so r161's done never happens in a real run. A probe confirms it: True without ledger.md, False with it. The scenario's fixture writes no ledger.
Observations: undelivered raised requests are not checked (r105 vs r161); an abandoned initiative can be set done; an unused noqa at supervision_proposal_steps.py:172.
tools check: ruff 6 errors, 1 from these commits (RUF100); vulture clean. size: nothing over 300.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_glossary.py:66-67: glossary_only_done counts the initiative's ledger.md (no kind) as a non-glossary proposal, so an initiative that changes only the glossary is never set done in a real run (r161); skip ledger.md as model_work.py:142 and workqueue_status.py:41 do, and give the r161 Given a ledger line
